div.p:
- id: int {id}
- email: String {unique}
- idNumber: String[8] {unique}
- fullName: String
- passwordHash: String
- role: Role
- approved: Boolean = false
- createdAt: DateTime
- deletionRequestedAt: DateTime [0..1]
- /tools: String [*]
- /deletionPending: Boolean

+ register(data: UserCreate): User
+ login(idNumber: String, password: String): AccessToken
+ me(): User
+ verifyPassword(password: String): Boolean
